description: A Compose UI test under the instrumented source set. It matches android-ui-test-reviewer's default trigger `**/androidTest/**`, so that reviewer must fire. It also matches test-reviewer's generic `**/*Test.*`, so test-reviewer legitimately fires too (routing is tolerant of extra fires). The src/main and API/UI-React/presentation reviewers must NOT fire: the path is neither src/main, nor api/controller/dto, nor *.test.tsx, nor under presentation/.
